guideMeta.label: Steps to connect a Meta account

app.title: Create the Meta app with the WhatsApp use case
app.hint: In Meta for Developers, My apps, Create app: choose the WhatsApp use case meant for exchanges with customers and attach the app to your business's Meta Business portfolio. Meta also creates a test account and a test number, which can be used here.

number.title: Prepare the WhatsApp number dedicated to the AI agent
number.hint: Add it in WhatsApp Manager, Phone numbers. Optional to start with the test number.

guideMeta.dedicatedText: A number used in the WhatsApp Business app must first be deleted there: its account in the app and its conversation history are lost. Keeping that number both in the app and on the API (coexistence) will only be possible with Meta Connect, once it is available.

token.title: Create a system user and generate a non-expiring token
token.hint: Business settings, Users, System users: add a system user, then assign it the app and the WhatsApp Business account, with full control. Then generate a token for this app, with no expiry, with the whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging permissions.

waba.title: Find the WABA ID
waba.hint: WhatsApp Manager, Account overview: the WhatsApp Business account ID is shown under its name. It is also in your Meta app, WhatsApp, API Setup.
waba.warning: It is neither the ID of a phone number, nor the app ID, nor the Meta business portfolio ID: with one of these values, Meta refuses the connection.

secret.title: Find the app secret
secret.hint: In your Meta app: App settings, Basic, App secret, Show.

recommended.title: Recommended
recommended.hint: Not needed to connect the account, but advised before answering real contacts.
recommended.publish: Publish the app: in your Meta app, switch the app mode from Development to Live.
recommended.payment: Add the WhatsApp account's payment method, in WhatsApp Manager, Account settings. It is not the ads payment method.
recommended.verification: Start business verification: Business settings, Security centre. Without it, Meta limits sending.
recommended.appSecretProof: Turn on "Require app secret": App settings, Advanced. Meta then only accepts calls that prove they know the app secret.

guideCm.label: Steps to connect a CM.com account

account.title: Find the CM.com account ID
account.hint: The accountId is an identifier (GUID) of your account, shown in the CM.com platform.

token.title: Find the productToken
token.hint: The productToken is in the CM.com Channels application, under the "API Access and Settings" menu then "Authentication". It may also have been given to you by your CM.com contact. It gives access to your messages: do not share it.

fields.name: Account name in WABAGENT
fields.wabaIdHint: Shown in WhatsApp Manager and in your Meta app's API configuration.

errors.name: Give the account a name, 80 characters at most.
errors.accessToken: Access token incomplete: paste it in full.
errors.appSecret: App secret incomplete: paste it in full.
errors.accountId: The CM.com account ID is a UUID, for example 0b1f2d3c-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-9a0b1c2d3e4f.
errors.productToken: productToken incomplete: paste it in full.
errors.tooLong: Value too long: make sure you pasted only the value.
errors.failed: Could not connect the account. Please try again.

connectFlow.footNote: Nothing is saved while the verification fails.
